title: Triton: DirectX 11 Driver for QEMU
summary: Triton is a newly developed DirectX 11 graphics driver designed to enable hardware-accelerated DirectX 11 rendering within QEMU virtual machines, significantly improving graphics performance for Windows guests running on emulated/virtualized environments like macOS.
problem_solved: Enables high-performance DirectX 11 graphics acceleration in virtualized Windows environments where traditional software rendering or limited GPU passthrough options fall short.
why_valuable: This driver bridges the graphics performance gap in cross-platform virtualization, allowing users to run Windows DirectX 11 applications and games smoothly on non-Windows hosts like macOS through QEMU.
